description.en-US: The schema name of the record this event is about: purchase_order or purchase_agreement. A plain string rather than an enum, because a new auditable resource must not require a schema migration to be recordable.
The record the event is about. No foreign key: an audit event must outlive the record it describes, and a cascade would delete exactly the history someone is auditing.
Who did it. Optional because a transition may be made by a scheduled job rather than a person, and recording a fake user id would be worse than recording none.
Whatever else the action needs recorded — the merged order ids, the alternatives cancelled. Free-form on purpose: pinning a column per action would make every new action a migration.
